results.title: From standalone CCS projects to a thriving European market for CO₂ [Promoted Content]
results.content: Europe is moving beyond CCS ambition into delivery. Across the continent, projects are entering operation, construction or advanced development, demonstrating that carbon management can support both industrial competitiveness and climate goals. The next challenge is to connect standalone projects into viable value chains, using industrial clusters, infrastructure, pragmatic regulation and targeted de-risking to turn Europe’s project pipeline into a thriving CO₂ market.
